title: P1 direct dependency license observations
method: Static extraction of direct importer resolved versions from pinned pnpm v9 lockfiles; read-only npm registry package metadata lookup. No install or execution.
limitations: Registry metadata endpoint returns package-level latest version and license, not arbitrary pinned version metadata. A version_exact=true row is an exact match at observation time; a version_exact=false row must remain unresolved for the pinned version.
This covers direct dependencies only, not all 1,918 transitive lockfile package versions.
Do not treat package-level latest license as proof that older locked versions have identical licensing.
Exact-version SBOM license fields remain NOASSERTION until each pinned package version's license is independently established.
